name: Guo Liang

name: Georgia Gaveras
profile: Dr. Georgia Gaveras, DO, is a triple-board-certified psychiatrist (adult, child & adolescent, addiction medicine) who co-founded Talkiatry in 2019 with Robert Krayn. The New York telepsychiatry practice now has 800+ psychiatrists and raised a $210M Series D in 2026. As CMO she sets clinical standards and co-authors Talkiatry's outcomes research.
interesting_fact: In 2025 she was named to Modern Healthcare's 50 Most Influential Clinical Executives and to Inc.'s Female Founders 500.
deep_cut_fact: Before Talkiatry she directed the Comprehensive Psychiatric Emergency Program (CPEP) at Kings County Hospital in Brooklyn. She studied at NYU, earned her DO at the University of New England in Biddeford, Maine, and trained at SUNY Downstate.
notes: Her clinical focus has been adolescents and young adults with co-occurring substance-use disorders. She is a co-author of a 2023 JMIR telepsychiatry outcomes study. Route via Talkiatry press.

name: Bernt Øivind Børnich
current_role: Founder & CEO, 1X Technologies (humanoid robots; Palo Alto / Moss, Norway)
profile: Norwegian roboticist who founded Halodi Robotics in Moss, Norway, in 2014. It built the wheeled humanoid EVE, partnered with OpenAI in 2022, and rebranded as 1X to focus on home humanoids. Its bipedal NEO went on pre-order in Oct 2025, and full-scale production began at 1X's Hayward, California factory in April 2026.
interesting_fact: He is a leading advocate of low-energy, tendon-driven actuation that keeps joints soft and compliant on contact. He argues home robots must be safe by design, not like high-gear-ratio industrial arms.
deep_cut_fact: In 2023 he lived with a 1X EVE robot at home for a while. In his TED2025 talk he described it emptying the dishwasher and bringing him tea while he played board games with friends.
notes: Very public: TED speaker, NYT Hard Fork guest. 1X has a press gallery (1x.tech/press) but no published press email. He predicts household robots could be in 10% of US homes by around 2030. Strong fit for an energy/AI podcast.
